rovid.hu: Az általános lelki jóllétet méri az elmúlt két hétben.
rovid.ro: Măsoară starea generală de bine psihic în ultimele două săptămâni.
rovid.en: Measures your general mental well-being over the last two weeks.

forras: World Health Organization. The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5). Geneva: WHO; 2024. Hivatalos fordítások: Psychiatric Research Unit, Mental Health Centre North Zealand (WHO Collaborating Centre).
licenc: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO – a forrás feltüntetése kötelező; nem kereskedelmi felhasználás.
hivatkozas: © World Health Organization 2024. The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5). Licenc: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.

bevezeto.en: Please indicate for each of the five statements which is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks. Notice that higher numbers mean better well-being.

valaszok.en: More than half of the time
Less than half of the time

kerdesek.en: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

szoveg.hu: A pontszám nagyon alacsony jóllétre utal. Ebben a tartományban kifejezetten javasolt szakemberrel beszélni, mert a háttérben hangulatzavar (például depresszió) is állhat.
szoveg.ro: Scorul indică o stare de bine foarte scăzută. În acest interval este puternic recomandat să vorbești cu un specialist, deoarece în spate se poate afla o tulburare de dispoziție (de exemplu depresie).
szoveg.en: The score indicates very low well-being. In this range it is strongly recommended to talk to a professional, as a mood disorder (such as depression) may be involved.

szoveg.hu: A pontszám alacsony jóllétet jelez. A WHO ajánlása szerint 50 alatti érték esetén érdemes további felmérést végezni.
szoveg.ro: Scorul indică o stare de bine scăzută. Conform recomandării OMS, la valori sub 50 merită făcută o evaluare suplimentară.
szoveg.en: The score indicates low well-being. According to the WHO, a score below 50 warrants further assessment.

nev.ro: Nu indică o stare de bine scăzută

szoveg.hu: A pontszám nem utal alacsony jóllétre. A magasabb érték jobb jóllétet jelent.
szoveg.ro: Scorul nu indică o stare de bine scăzută. O valoare mai mare înseamnă o stare de bine mai bună.
szoveg.en: The score does not indicate low well-being. Higher values mean better well-being.
